summary.description: Toluene is a colourless, highly flammable liquid that is part of the BTEX group of pollutants. It is used primarily as a solvent and fuel additive, and is also found in paints, thinners, adhesives, and printing processes.
emission_sources: Evaporation from products like paint, thinners, adhesives, nail polish
Industrial and consumer product use and disposal
environmental_impact: Can cause harm to eyes, throat, brain, and unborn child upon high exposure
Evaporates quickly and does not persist in soil or surface water
Contributes to formation of ground-level ozone, which is harmful to health and vegetation

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Toluene can have serious health effects such as damage to the brain, eyes, throat, and fetal development after high exposure, making it a public health concern.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Toluene is widely used in consumer and industrial products. Managing its use, emissions, and disposal is critical for sustainable consumption practices.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG11_Sustainable_Cities_and_Communities: Due to its role in forming ground-level ozone, toluene affects urban air quality and contributes to environmental health challenges in cities.
